column1: # SUPER ROBOT WARS V on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# SDK 6, NVN, update 1.0.2 (v131072) with 7 DLC. The same engine as SUPER ROBOT WARS T (01006C900CC60000: subsdk0 and sdk byte for byte the same), so its
# settings carry over; the game profile beside this is the provisional one porter wrote from the survey (not checked by hand); the shader tables are its own.
# Text is drawn with the system shared font (nn::fontll): build with --shared-font <Korean TTF>, or the Korean text has no glyphs (the device's Roboto has no Hangul).
